tweets.author: karpathy
tweets.text: A small eval on long-context retrieval: once you leave the needle-in-haystack setup, most models drop more than the leaderboards suggest.

tweets.author: bank_of_latvia
tweets.text: Latvia's overnight deposits ticked up again. The series is noisy week to week, but the 12-week slope is still the useful number.

tweets.author: defi_data
tweets.text: Funding flipped negative on the usual suspects. Not a crash signal by itself; more like the market paying people to be long again.

clusters.headline: Markets are paying for longs again
clusters.synthesis: Funding went negative while Latvian deposits kept drifting up. Two different clocks, same mood: people parking cash and still wanting upside.

picks.reason: Useful eval, not a model launch.
picks.commentary: This is the kind of AI post worth keeping: a concrete failure mode, not a demo. If a tool only looks good on needle-in-haystack, it is not ready for the way you actually search.

actions.label: Steal: test beyond needle-in-haystack
actions.detail: Reuse as an eval gate for retrieval tools

picks.nugget_why: Concrete failure mode you can reuse as an eval gate.
